evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: Taking inspiration from algorithm configuration, we introduce AdaEva, a drop-in adaptive partial-evaluation framework that progressively evaluates candidates on larger subsets of the same instance pool and eliminates unpromising candidates as evidence accumulates.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: This instance-wise structure raises a natural question: must every candidate be evaluated on the entire instance set before deciding whether it remains competitive?

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Under matched evaluation budgets, AdaEva more reliably balances evaluation effort across candidates than fixed partial-evaluation strategies, yielding strong search efficiency and anytime performance together with improved held-out generalization across the evaluated settings.
